identification: Mater Dolorosa type head of the Virgin in blue veil and red, oil on canvas, after Carlo Dolci / Sassoferrato school; probably a 19th-century copy. Canvas stencil of Winsor & Newton (Limited), 38 Rathbone Place London (c.1880s-1930s). Heavy carved gilt gesso frame, with losses.
